title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
slides: Is the AI spending boom starting to crack?
Hyperscalers poured billions into data centers this year
But utilization rates tell a different story
Your cloud bill may soon reflect this imbalance
Audit one AI vendor contract this week
thread_text:
1. The AI spending bubble question

Hyperscalers poured billions into data centers this year, but utilization rates are painting a very different picture. The gap between investment and actual use is widening.

2. Utilization tells the real story

Capacity is being built faster than workloads can fill it. That imbalance doesn't stay on a balance sheet — it moves toward pricing.

3. Your cloud bill is next

Providers will need to recover underused capacity somehow. Expect adjustments that show up in your invoices, not in press releases.

4. The imbalance has a deadline

When utilization lags spending, the correction rarely happens quietly. It hits contracts, renewals, and committed spend.

5. Audit one contract now

Pull a single AI vendor agreement today and check the utilization clauses. If you can't find them, that's your answer.
